102718.overview: Snake Roy is a Jigsaw puzzle game (game of the "snake"), developed by Sachen and published by Timlex International Limited, which was released in 1993.

102719.overview: Street Rider is a race game (clone of the game Rally-X, classic of Namco in the Arcades in the 80s), developed by Commin and published by Timlex International Limited, which was released in 1993.

148991.overview: Suleiman's Treasure is an Adventure game, developed by Commin and published by Timlex International Limited, which was released in 1993.
